== Summary ==
Identified: [[Emil Wallin]] (blonde bun, sunglasses on his head, white shirt, and a tattoo on his forearm; same face as [[:File:Emil Wallin 2018 World Championship.jpg]]) and [[Tamás Papp]] (grey shirt, white watch; same face as his community-card portrait).

The 2023 Naboo Regionals ("Foil Fest") weekend in Liverpool, UK (2–4 June 2023), hosted by Team Wales.

* '''Event:''' [[2023 Regional Championships]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2023-05-31
* '''Identification:''' [[Emil Wallin]] (blonde bun, sunglasses on his head, white shirt, and a tattoo on his forearm; same face as [[:File:Emil Wallin 2018 World Championship.jpg]]) and [[Tamás Papp]] (grey shirt, white watch; same face as his community-card portrait).
